name: CYCLE (formerly GetHenry)
what: Full-service e-bike and e-cargo-bike leasing/subscription for couriers and last-mile delivery fleets.
homonym_note: HOMONYM: the 20VC sibling row 'Cycle' is a different company (Paris product-feedback SaaS from the eFounders studio, Boldstart-led). This row is the Berlin e-bike fleet company cycle.eco, formerly GetHenry.

membership.basis: Live visionaries.vc portfolio; TechCrunch names Visionaries Club in the GetHenry seed.
membership.quote: was led by LocalGlobe, with participation from Visionaries Club, Founder Collective

entry.quote: a combination of €10 million equity and €6.5 million debt, was led by LocalGlobe

graduation.quote: Berlin-based CYCLE swifts €10.3 million in Series A

notes: Renamed from GetHenry to CYCLE in 2022 (company release: launched in 2018 'still under the name GetHenry'; TechCrunch headline 2022-07-20 'GetHenry changes name to Cycle'). Seed May 2022: $17.4M = EUR 10M equity + EUR 6.5M debt, LocalGlobe lead, with Visionaries Club, Founder Collective, EnBW New Ventures, GreenPoint, SpeedUp, Third Sphere (TechCrunch 2022-05-10); the equity part alone is EUR 10M. Series A July 2023: EUR 10.3M ($11.3M) led by Scania Growth Capital with LocalGlobe, EnBW New Ventures, Visionaries Club, Third Sphere, Founder Collective, APX and SpeedUp, 'who were already on board as investors' (eu-startups 2023-07-19, read via Wayback because eu-startups refuses curl; the company's own release at ride.cycle.eco, dated Berlin July 10, now loads only via Wayback). Later: acquired UK maker Ebike4Delivery (Bike Europe / Zag Daily headlines, July 2024); new cargo e-bike model (Zag Daily headline 2025-06-03); site live 2026 (100 cities). No insolvency or sale found (Google News + WebSearch, to 2026-09). Focus: light-EV subscription/fleet service for couriers; no bucket fits cleanly (Consumer & Marketplaces chosen; Climate & Energy or Industrial & Robotics are alternatives); the Paris 'Cycle' sibling's SaaS focus does not apply.
